# Data notice

SAM 3.1's answer (Meta Model API, prompt "magenta line", Oct 28 2026) for Figure 4.2 of the
2005 Volve development plan (PUD, page 23), as it came, and the curve file
`wellpilot.ingest.figure` built from it. A test fixture: the curve must be rebuilt from the
answer exactly, so a change in the parser or the reading shows.

`log_plots/`: SAM 3.1's answers (Oct 28 2026; prompts "green area", "cyan area", "black
area") for the rate tracks of F-12's production-log plots: Appendices B-D of "Volve
15/9-F-12 Production Logging Interpretation Results, March 2009" and the September 2010 PLT
plot. The readings saved in `../plt/production_log_plots.json` must rebuild from them.

The figure and the plots are part of the Volve field dataset. Contains data from the Volve field dataset,
made available by Equinor and the former Volve license partners (ExxonMobil Exploration &
Production Norway AS, Bayerngas Norge AS) under the Equinor Open Data Licence:
https://www.equinor.com/content/dam/statoil/documents/what-we-do/Equinor-HRS-Terms-and-conditions-for-licence-to-data-Volve.pdf
